_comment: Written by build-props.mjs. This week's NFL player props (The Odds API) for DFFL-rostered players, each set against Sleeper's stat projection: p_market is the no-vig market chance of the listed side, p_model the projection's, p the two blended half and half, edge = p - p_market, ev the blend's return at the best price, score a 0-100 confidence. Read by the Props board on the Odds tab.
